extra.probe_method: speech round trip (see internal/agent/speech_eval.go): a pinned sentence in a named language is rendered by the TTS engine and the resulting audio is transcribed by the ASR engine, then the transcript is scored against the sentence we started from. The reference is known because we wrote it, so no labelled corpus is shipped. realtime_factor is processing seconds / audio seconds against the TRUE duration read from the WAV header, never estimated. The error rate is a JOINT score for the pair — attribute it to one engine only when the other is held fixed, which is why speech_reference_model is recorded beside it.
extra.speech_transcript: How many deployments are running on my gram right now?
